shell_commands: ls -la src/orchestration/tools/*.test.ts 2>/dev/null || echo "No test files yet"
timeout 120 npm run prettier -- --write CHANGELOG.md docs/adding-a-tool.md example/weather-tool.ts README.md .specify/spec.md 2>&1

git add .lore/dod.md .specify/spec.md CHANGELOG.md README.md docs/adding-a-tool.md example/weather-tool.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
docs: update documentation for tool input validation feature

Update CHANGELOG.md, README.md, docs/adding-a-tool.md, example/weather-tool.ts,
and .specify/spec.md to reflect that ToolRegistry.execute now validates input
against the declared inputSchema before invoking executors. Invalid input
returns a ToolResponse with an error message instead of throwing, allowing
the model to correct the call within the tool-round budget.

Executors no longer need to perform defensive casting or handle missing input
gracefully — the input has already passed schema validation. Unknown keys may
still be present (the schema does not inject additionalProperties: false).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git status && git push origin HEAD
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main
